agent_user.name: agent_user
agent_user.note: agent, uid 1000; not checked: file capabilities (no getcap); net_admin stays in its commands' capability sets: docker starts them itself, with the container's sets, so BenchFlow cannot drop it, and no file on its PATH or in the system folders gives it the firewall (file capabilities (no getcap) unchecked); its probe could not change the firewall

clean_verifier_env.name: clean_verifier_env
clean_verifier_env.note: no loader variables, PYTHONSAFEPATH off: left to the image, as 0.8 runs this task format, PATH of root-owned folders only

cloud_metadata.name: cloud_metadata
cloud_metadata.note: the uid firewall refuses TCP from every user, root included (the reference solution runs as root) to the cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254, 169.254.170.2, 169.254.170.23, 100.100.100.200, 168.63.129.16, 169.254.0.23, fd00:ec2::254, fd00:ec2::23, fd20:ce::254, fd00:c1::a9fe:a9fe) on every port but 53; proof: the agent user's connect to 169.254.169.254:80 was refused and the rule counted 1 packet

hidden_verifier.name: hidden_verifier
hidden_verifier.note: the verifier and oracle are uploaded only when needed

ld_so_preload.name: ld_so_preload
ld_so_preload.note: absent before and after the agent's turn

locked_system_dirs.name: locked_system_dirs
locked_system_dirs.note: the image lets group or others write 4 paths in system folders; removed that permission before the agent ran: /usr/share/man/man8 (775), /usr/share/man/man5 (775), /usr/share/man/man1 (775), /usr/share/man/man7 (775)

locked_system_path.name: locked_system_path
locked_system_path.note: the folders on PATH are root's alone

memory_limit.name: memory_limit
memory_limit.note: the task sets no memory limit, so the sandbox may use all 128799 MB its host has

network_policy.name: network_policy
network_policy.note: agent: open: everything but the cloud metadata endpoints (see cloud_metadata)

oom_order.name: oom_order
oom_order.note: agent processes start at oom_score_adj 1000, the runner and the verifier at 0, so the kernel stops the agent's first

services_network.name: services_network
services_network.note: 1 service(s) on a private network with no route out and no address for the host

sidecar__6770caec/prompts.json: A service named `api` answers HTTP on port 8000 beside your container. Fetch `http://api:8000/token` and write the response body, exactly, to `/app/token.txt`.
